text: Vítejte u Pana Změny! Dnes prodáváme… to se ještě uvidí.
pokyny: Voice acting for a comedy point-and-click adventure game. Speak Czech with native pronunciation, natural pacing and comic timing. Do not read stage directions. Character: Mr. Change, hidden voice behind a market stall, giddy, changes his mind mid-sentence. Delivery: enthusiastically.
